newsitem.title: FRANCE: Signaux says wants to double turnover.
newsitem.headline: Signaux says wants to double turnover.

text.p: French electronics and defence group Cie de Signaux wants to double its turnover "in about two years, to reach four to five billion francs," Signaux chairman Yasid Sabeg said.
"Bearing in mind our financial situation, we have the means for very strong external growth," he said in an interview with weekly Journal des Finances due to appear on Saturday.
He said that, between now and June 1997, the group would achieve "the majority of this external growth."
Signaux reported first half 1996 net attributable profit of 42 million francs with turnover of 915 million francs.
